display.purpose: H1 wordmark only, once per page.

label.purpose: Uppercase section headings and pill text.

shadows.name: pulse-ring
shadows.purpose: Verification pill's expanding pulse; the only box-shadow in the system, and it is transient.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Verification dot ring expansion; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

backdrops.name: hero-glow
backdrops.value: radial-gradient(60rem 30rem ellipse at 50% -12rem, var(--glow), transparent 65%) no-repeat
backdrops.purpose: Full-bleed faint indigo glow behind the hero; the page's only depth cue at rest.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Page-inverted filled action; GitHub CTA in the hero.
components.html: GitHub
components.css: .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.62rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--btn-primary-bg); color: var(--btn-primary-fg); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .btn:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined surface action; Keybase proof CTA in the hero.
components.html: Keybase 証明を見る
components.css: .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.62rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); background: var(--surface); color: var(--fg); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .btn:hover { border-color: var(--muted); } .btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Verification Pill
components.description: Signature element: Keybase-proof pill with pulsing accent dot.
components.html: Keybase で検証済み
components.css: .pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem; background: var(--surface); transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .pill:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--fg); } .pulse { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); animation: pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite; } @keyframes pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-soft); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px transparent; } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent; } }

components.name: Link List Row
components.description: Hairline-bordered editorial index row: icon, label, note, reveal-on-hover arrow.
components.html: • …GitHubコード・プロジェクト…
components.css: .links li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline); } .links li:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline); } .links a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 0.4rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease; } .links a:hover { background: var(--hover); } .links a:hover .icon { color: var(--accent); } .arrow { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-4px, 4px); transition: opacity 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .links a:hover .arrow { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

narrative.northStar: 署名で裏打ちされた静けさ (Quietness backed by a signature)
narrative.overview: This system does not shout. Identity is asserted once — in a giant, precisely-tracked wordmark — and then verified: a single pulsing accent dot tied to a real Keybase proof. Where the category default is a grid of chatty self-introduction cards, this page is a vertical stack of hairline rules and whitespace. One indigo accent is the only voice; everything else is pure neutral, inverting cleanly between OS light and dark themes. Structure comes from lines, not surfaces. Depth is a single faint radial glow behind the hero — atmosphere, not elevation. Typography is the protagonist: Geist Sans at extreme sizes with tightened tracking, Geist Mono for the cryptographic fingerprint, Japanese text falling to Hiragino/Noto system fallbacks.
keyCharacteristics: Two full OS-following themes, identical structure, inverted neutrals
Single indigo accent reserved for verification, focus, and hover reveals
Hairline dividers instead of card surfaces; no shadows at rest
Verification pill with 2.4s pulsing dot as the signature element
150ms ease transitions; reduced-motion disables all animation

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo is reserved for verification, focus, and hover reveals. It never fills a surface larger than a dot or a border. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: The primary button always inverts against the page: dark-fill/light-text in light theme, light-fill/dark-text in dark theme. It is neutral, never accent-colored.

rules.name: The Mono-as-Proof Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only where cryptographic identity is spoken (fingerprint, keybase.txt). Don't use it for decoration.

dos: Do pair every color change with its dark-theme twin; both themes are first-class.
Do keep all transitions at 150ms ease and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use 1px hairlines (--hairline) for all divisions and containment.
Do reserve Geist Mono for fingerprints, proofs, and machine-facing metadata.
Do invert the primary button against the current theme's page background.
donts: Don't add box-shadows or card surfaces; the system is built from lines and whitespace.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or gradient fills.
Don't use the accent as a large background fill, badge, or tag color.
Don't fabricate content — the page states only verified facts and confirmed links.
Don't track the display type loosely; −0.04em at 800 weight is the look.
